Events

While the majority of our lectures and seminars are not open to the general public we are expanding our range of public lectures that showcase the power and beauty of our subject.

We have the largest purpose-built lecture theatres and conference facilities in Oxford, providing the perfect venue for your conferences and events. 

Lectures for the department are also open to other members of the University. In some cases registration may be necessary.
 

Local logistics

Talks will be held in the Mathematical Institute, Andrew Wiles Building, Radcliffe Observatory Quarter, Woodstock Road, Oxford [map]. See the travel and maps page for further travel information.
 

Departmental Seminars & Events

Please note that the list below only shows forthcoming events, which may not include regular events that have not yet been entered for the forthcoming term. Please see the past events page for a list of all seminar series that the department has on offer.

 

  • Algebraic and Symplectic Geometry Seminar (7)
  • Computational Mathematics and Applications Seminar (9)
  • Geometry and Analysis Seminar (7)
  • History of Mathematics Seminar (1)
  • Industrial and Applied Mathematics Seminar (1)
  • Machine Learning and Data Science Seminar (5)
  • Mathematical Biology and Ecology Seminar (8)
  • Mathematical Biology Seminar (1)
  • Numerical Analysis Group Internal Seminar (2)
  • Oxford Mathematics Public Lectures (1)
  • Public Events (2)
  • Stochastic Analysis Seminar (1)
